summary.intent: Address CodeRabbit review comments on PR #372 (writable shares PoC), then extend the feature to support writable individual file shares (not just folder shares).
summary.outcome: All 7 inline review threads resolved (4 real fixes, 3 false positives dismissed), writable file share support added end-to-end (ShareDialog, navigation hooks, API DTOs, E2E tests), and a shared `ShareKeyType` / `ChildKeyType` abstraction introduced across the API.

repo: Subfolder IPNS private keys are ECIES-wrapped with the owner's public key in FolderEntry.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted — recipients cannot unwrap them directly, requiring a separate `folder-ipns` share_key stored at creation time.
The owner's subfolder IPNS key unwrap flow lives in useFolderNavigation.ts:235; the shared navigation hook (useSharedNavigation.ts) needs its own parallel mechanism.
shareKeysCache is used to avoid redundant API calls for share keys but was never invalidated after addShareKeys() calls — a subtle stale-cache bug.
ShareDialog.tsx calls sharesControllerCreateShare directly (bypassing share.service.ts createShare wrapper), so share.service.ts changes don't affect the dialog flow.
The ChildKeyDto in create-share.dto.ts and InviteChildKeyDto were separate inline union types (`'file' | 'folder'`) rather than a shared type — caused cascading errors when adding new key types.
CodeRabbit posts reviews both as formal PR reviews and as issue-level comments; checking only one source will miss the review.
File shares at the top-level SharedFileBrowser list go through navigateToShare which previously triggered download for all file shares — no editor path existed before this session.

code.finding: Subfolder navigation did not update ipnsPrivateKeyRef — recipients lost write access after entering a subfolder. Fixed by storing a folder-ipns share_key at subfolder creation and looking it up on navigate.
shareKeysCache was never cleared after addShareKeys() calls, causing stale key lookups on subsequent operations.
Owner unwraps subfolder IPNS key from folderEntry.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted using their vault keypair — but this field is ECIES-wrapped for the owner only, so recipients cannot use the same path.
ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted is always wrapped with userPublicKey (owner's key only); no recipient wrapping happens at folder creation time.
Missing @ApiResponse({ status: 409 }) Swagger decorator for the revoked-share conflict response.
New shared type file introduced: CHILD_KEY_TYPES array and ShareKeyType / ChildKeyType union types, used by all DTOs and entities to avoid duplication.

workflow: When adding a new discriminant value to a string union type used across many DTOs, expect cascading type errors in generated API clients and all consumers — plan to update DTO, entity, response DTO, API client regeneration, and all web-side consumers in one pass.
Running `pnpm api:generate` must happen *after* all API-side type changes are complete; regenerating mid-session causes a second regeneration pass.
Pre-existing type errors in spec files (missing mock fields) can mask real type errors — check errors in the specific changed files, not the full tsc output.
CodeRabbit 'outside diff range' comments appear only in the review body, not in the inline thread list from the GitHub API — requires fetching the full review body separately.

friction: CodeRabbit review took ~10+ minutes to post after the review request, requiring polling loop with ~11 iterations of 60s waits.
Review count jumped from 14 to 30 unexpectedly, making it unclear which were new — had to cross-reference timestamps manually.
Regenerating the API client mid-session (before all type changes were done) caused a second regeneration pass and cascading type errors.
The subfolder write fix went through two complete rewrites: first a read-only downgrade approach, then the correct folder-ipns share_key approach after tracing the owner's IPNS key unwrap path.
The CodeRabbit file-share write comment was initially misread as a bug (folder-only restriction added, then reverted) before the valid use case (individual writable file shares) was recognized.
Lint failures on .then().catch() chain formatting required an extra fix cycle after the main implementation.
open_items: Non-text file write shares (images, PDFs) fall through to download in the file view — no dedicated UX for non-text writable file shares.
Writable file share upgrade path (read→write for existing file shares) was added to ShareDialog but not covered by E2E tests.
The `folder-ipns` share_key is only created for subfolders created *after* this PR — existing subfolders in write-shares won't have the key and will silently lose write access on re-navigation.
E2E tests for writable file shares (Phase 10+) were added but not yet run against a real environment — test correctness unverified.

The `navigateToBreadcrumb` IPNS key restoration for multi-level subfolder stacks was added but the nav stack entries don't store folderId at intermediate levels — deep breadcrumb navigation may not correctly restore the subfolder's IPNS key.
Invite flow (InviteChildKeyDto) now accepts file-ipns keys but invite.service.ts collectChildKeys logic for generating file-ipns child keys during invite creation was not implemented.
